facts.fact: The National Registration Bureau's ID4Africa 2025 slides show offline and online authentication of the national ID through an NRB-signed QR code and NRB middleware linking verification agents and relying parties to the NRIS.

The National Registration Bureau's ID4Africa 2025 slides show births registered with unique identifiers and deaths recorded with automated flagging in the NRIS, and an Act amendment moving the registration mandate from the Registrar General to the NRB.
The slides state registration of 3.5 million births with unique identifiers and recording of 179,000 deaths with automated flagging in the NRIS.
The National Registration Bureau reports 3.5 million births registered with unique identifiers and 179,000 deaths recorded in the NRIS.
The National Registration Bureau reports an electronic birth and death registration system in 142 health facilities with real-time data synchronisation.
